message.reasoning:
I'm looking at the poster, which reads as a washed-out, low-contrast Paris rooftop with a blue line, so it feels dull and faded. The owner had already picked EDIT, and I'm questioning whether that still holds. The frame is flat, and the owner has said they dislike boring, so I'm weighing whether to keep it or switch to AWESOME, since the change is only two seconds and cheap to make.

I'm weighing whether the washed-out, gray look is a fade overlay, which would point to EDIT again, or whether removing the seam means AWESOME fits better. The fix itself is just a plain crossfade, so I'm leaning toward keeping EDIT.
